summary.t: Christmas countdown in the shape of a gingerbread house: the magic of waiting

text.t:
Inspired by the charm of traditional gingerbread houses, this piece is crafted from pine plywood, featuring delicate white acrylic details and an elegant lace ribbon for hanging.
Designed to make the countdown to Christmas even more special, it allows you to write the number of days remaining until the most magical night of the year.
A delicate and timeless detail, celebrating the beauty of traditions and the joy of waiting for Christmas with your family.
